overview.description: The Tema MLCC & PowerSemi ETF (PSOX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests in US and non-US power semiconductors stocks. The ETF uses internal research and analysis to identify companies with significant exposure related to the development, design, distribution, or production of power semiconductor products PSOX was launched on Aug 17, 2026 and is issued by Tema.
